notes.title: Interlude Patch: Flip The Script
notes.notes: [p]Welcome back, Scribes! It's time for a flippin' new spell![/p][p]This update includes [b]Unfold[/b]: a new [b]Movement Spell[/b], [b]New Maps[/b], A Tutorial Kit adjustment, and some light fixes![/p][p]We also shout out the new Community Mod Library - hardworking Scribes making their mark on the game! Check out the highlights below and keep an eye on the [b]Roadmap[/b] in [i]Vellum's[/i] main menu as we go. [/p][p][/p][h1]New Movement Spell - Unfold[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/a5a37375b641d7abe825a5f3e2a90ad54426af74.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Mental gymnastics? Watch this![/i][/p][p]Keep an eye on your foes as you soar backwards through the air with [b]Unfold[/b]![/p][p]This acrobatic Movement Spell flings you out of danger, granting a brief moment of invulnerability, and offers many pages to build more style into your aerial feats![/p][p]Drop deadly mines, craft a winning floor routine, and perform some high-damage trick shots to style on your foes! [/p][p][/p][h1]New Maps[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/3029d285277d6cfb4fb2552f5902ee2459457104.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Roots and shoots and roads...[/i][/p][p]Venture to fresh combat arenas: [i]Sequoia[/i] and [i]Outlook[/i]! Fight beneath the tall trees, making use of long-range cover for a forest fight to be remembered.[/p][p]In [i]Outlook[/i], weave between pillars of an ancient structure - where do these old roads lead? Battle the Torn in a time-worn relic of elsewhere![/p][p] [/p][h1]Spend Early, Spend Often - Tutorial Spell Changes[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/19614c658a259af5c79f18998e931b200bc80ba4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Note: This will unlock Callback for all Scribes, while re-locking Swoop![/i][/p][p]We're making some initial changes to the new player experience with adjustments to the Tutorial Chapter! [/p][p]The order of some elements has changed to give Scribes more time to understand the Signature Ink choice they make. Additionally, we're making Callback the new default Spender Spell! [/p][p]This gives new Scribes a more versatile starting spell set to take into their first [i]Of Scribes and Torn[/i] run - Callback's area damage capabilities are a smoother compliment to Jot! [/p][p] [/p][h1]Community - Mods and More![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ca043850a17e45e86434c10453b0c58a160ffbee.jpg"][/img][i]Just a bit of tINKering...[/i][/p][p]There has been some awesome community work on Mods for Vellum! Pet the Inkling, pack more decoration into your Reading Nook, and more creative additions await! [/p][p]You can find these mods in the Discord Community Mods Library - a special thanks to the authors for your excitement and sharing your work![/p][p] [/p][h1]Epilogue[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/9b6c070b5d585ffb1e675a5be2accc603edff872.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]The quiet calm of a book club![/i][/p][p]Keep an eye out for [i]Vellum[/i] in the Yogscast Small Teams fest currently on Steam! In other news, we're gearing up for the next Major Chapter - more info to come, with plenty to read.[/p][p]Thank you to our testers, everyone in the discord, our newest mod-makers, and Scribes of all Ink Levels! [/p][p]- [i]The Vellum Team[/i][/p][p] [/p][h1]Interlude Patch: Flip The Script - Full Patch Notes [/h1][h2]Movement Spell: Unfold[/h2][p]- [b]Unfold[/b]: Acrobatically flip backwards, becoming Impervious for 0.3s.[/p][p]- New Pages of Power are available for [b]Unfold[/b][/p][p]- A new race and tower jump sequence can be found in the Illuminated Library[/p][h2]New Combat Arenas[/h2][p]- [i]Sequoia[/i] and [i]Outlook[/i] are now available in Tomes![/p][h2]General[/h2][p]- Re-ordered the hierarchy of Signature Status effects on enemy health bars (Outline > Blot > Leech)[/p][p]- Status and Augment effect calculation orders have been re-prioritized (this will result in slightly more damage intake through overlapping damage-reduction effects and an increase in specific damage-amp combinations)[/p][p]- Re-ordered some Tutorial Chapter elements[/p][p]- Tutorial Chapter now has Scribes start with Callback instead of Swoop (Note: this will unlock Callback for all Scribes and lock Swoop)[/p][p]- Adjusted default Camera sensitivity settings and ratios for vertical vs horizontal[/p][p]- Fixed an error in Credits screen[/p][p]- [b]Vignette: A Forgotten Grotto[/b] correctly offers a tradeoff page by default[/p][p]- Added a notification for Vignette rewards when there are no more pages to grant[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with [b]Page of Power: Father of Quill[/b][/p][p]- [b]Page of Power: Spotless Floor[/b] is available again, with a new design[i] - [/i]now adds +5 Base Damage to all instances of damage[/p][p]- [b]Page of Power: Overgrowth[/b] - Now increases Base Damage dealt based on amount of mana spent. (Note: will scale better in late game.)[/p][p]- [b]New Page of Power: The Main Drain[/b] - 25% of damage you deal is also done to your Target if they are tethered.[/p][p]- [b]New Page of Power: Draining Force II[/b] - Draining Force always deals damage equal to  100% of your current health  to tethered foes.[/p][p]- [b]New Page of Power: Ode to the West Wind[/b] - Foil slashes send out Wind Blades that deal 20 Damage and generate a small amount of mana.[/p][p]- [b]Spell:[/b] [b]Draw[/b] - Base Damage reduced from 15 to 12.[/p][p]- [b]Spell: Draw[/b] - Cooldown increased from 0.85s to 0.9s.[/p][p]- [b]Spell: Foil[/b] - First Slash Damage increased from 15 to 20.[/p][p]- [b]Spell: Foil[/b] - Final Slash Damage increased from 25 to 35.[/p][p]- [b]Spell: Foil[/b] - Mana Generation increased by 25%.[/p][p]- [b]Spell: Jot[/b] - Cooldown decreased from 0.5s to 0.45s.[/p][p]- [b]Spell: Manifest[/b] - Base Damage increased from 10 to 12.[/p][p]- [b]Vignette: Thesis, a Ship Rewritten[/b] has received minor adjustments[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Interlude Patch: "Spoilers"
notes.notes: [p]Welcome back, Scribes! With [i]1.1: Beyond[/i] now [i]behind[/i] us, we look to new waters - beginning with a fresh new spell! [/p][p][/p][p]--[b] Interlude Patch: "Spoilers"[/b] ahead... --[/p][p][/p][p]This update includes [b]Spoil[/b]: a new [b]Spender Spell[/b], [b]Visual Intensity Settings[/b], [b]Raid-Specific Spell Tuning[/b], and several bug fixes, minor adjustments! Keep an eye out for some snazzy new Nook Items, too![/p][p]Check out the highlights below and, as always, you can track our journey from the [b]Roadmap[/b] in [i]Vellum's[/i] main menu. We also discuss our continuing [i]Vellum[/i] plans at the end of this post! [/p][p][/p][h1]New Spender Spell - Spoil[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/16ffa559c7abe9523acca579c82564a250d5801f.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]How 'bout them apples?[/i][/p][p]Brand new to the spellbook, Scribes get to live a fresh, ripe, totally-not-rotten fairytale fantasy with [b]Spoil[/b]! [/p][p]"Offer" your foes a scrumptious bite of a [b][i]Spoiled Apple[/i][/b] and watch as they share their positive reviews with nearby pals! These Apples are tasty, healthy, and only get better with a hefty helping of Pages of Power![/p][p]Aim true while flinging bushel after bushel of this [b]sticky, explosive 1-Cost Spender[/b]... and find out just how hungry the Torn [i]really[/i] are.[/p][p][/p][h1]Visual Intensity Settings[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8050a093ceadb6206fd5c597019823b10435b378.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Details and details and details![/i][/p][p]We're introducing [b]Visual Intensity Settings[/b] based on your feedback! These new options allow you to further customize your experience for [i]increased performance and legibility[/i] both solo and in multiplayer. [/p][p]In pursuit of these changes, our VFX system has had performance improvements across the board (even without using these new settings!). [/p][p]Player spells and effects now have a Reduced and Minimal VFX setting.[/p][p]Enemy abilities and effects now have a Reduced and Minimal VFX setting.[/p][p]There are a lot of visuals in [i]Vellum[/i] - please let us know how your experience with these new settings goes![/p][p][/p][h1]Raid-Specific Spell Tuning and Balance[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/a2b6a6dfee75b65e0fbd68d4c62b08e004ee6285.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]The flexible spellcraft of Scribes is a complex curriculum. Time to teach the Torn Lords a lesson or two.[/i][/p][p]With the rise of the Torn Lords, we've found (with the help of plenty of feedback!) the disparity between spell damage across the different loadout options in Raids is larger than we'd like! [/p][p]The lower number of pages available in Raids combined with the Boss/Single-Target heavy encounter profiles, has resulted in some spells falling behind in power/excitement. With [b]Interlude Patch: Spoilers[/b], we're pumping up the damage output of several spells when [b]damaging Raid Bosses only[/b]. [/p][p][b]Foil[/b], [b]Punctuate[/b], [b]Enkindle[/b], [b]Quip[/b], [b]Blossom[/b], [b]Wordsmith[/b], and [b]Passage[/b] will now deal [b]20 - 66% increased damage to Raid Bosses[/b] (details in the patch notes below). Let us know how these feel![/p][p][/p][h1]Epilogue[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/cea9b5b888446e2f286fae829d201515c518cc84.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Finding a cozy nook in the Illuminated Library to keep reading![/i][/p][p]With [b]The Grey Area[/b], [b]The Forgery[/b], and [b]Yonder[/b] now complete along with the [b]Early Access[/b] journey - we're going to be adjusting our cadence of content! We're incredibly proud of the speed, quality, and quantity of [i]Vellum's[/i] [b]Major Chapters[/b] and [b]Interlude Patches[/b] thus far... especially when we're operating as such a small team (if you're active in the [url="https://discord.gg/vellum"]Discord[/url] - you've likely heard from all of us directly by this point!)[/p][p]Since EA launch, we [i]typically[/i] added new content about [b]every two weeks[/b], alternating between [b]Interludes[/b] and [b]Major Chapters[/b]. Of course, some updates had adjusted timings for major life events and bigger-scope items (especially as the Library Update, Raids, and 1.0 approached). [/p][p]As a small team, we'll remain incredibly flexible (today's patch includes feedback from [i]this morning - [/i]we love this!), but we'll be targeting a few more weeks between updates and more [b]Interludes[/b] between [b]Major Chapters[/b]. This new pace lets us stay reactive to feedback, continue to chase cool ideas, and gives us more time to plan what comes next![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing [i]Vellum [/i]and joining us as the literary journey continues to unfold! Go read a book![/p][p]- [i]The Vellum Team[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]Interlude Patch: "Spoilers" - Full Patch Notes [/h1][h2]Features[/h2][h3]Spender Spell: Spoil[/h3][p]- Cost: 1 Mana[/p][p]- Sling a [b]Spoiled Apple[/b] that [b]sticks[/b] to foes and [b]bursts[/b] after a short delay.[/p][p]- New [b]Spoil[/b] Pages of Power are now available![/p][h3]Visual Intensity Settings[/h3][p]- Player spells and effects now have a Reduced and Minimal VFX setting[/p][p]- Enemy abilities and effects now have a Reduced and Minimal VFX setting[/p][p]- VFX performance improved baseline[/p][p][/p][h2]Tuning, General, Fixes[/h2][p]- New Nook Objects are now available for purchase and loot drops in Tomes/Raids[/p][p]- [b]Generator: Punctuate[/b] now deals +20% damage to Raid Bosses[/p][p]- [b]Generator: Enkindle[/b] now deals +25% damage to Raid Bosses[/p][p]- [b]Generator: Foil[/b] now deals +35% damage to Raid Bosses[/p][p]- [b]Generator: Quip[/b] now deals +50% damage to Raid Bosses[/p][p]- [b]Spender: Wordsmith[/b] now deals +25% damage to Raid Bosses[/p][p]- [b]Spender: Passage[/b] now deals +50% damage to Raid Bosses[/p][p]- [b]Spender: Blossom[/b] now deals +66% damage to Raid Bosses[/p][p]- [b]Page of Power: New Sponge[/b] no longer purges Blot, now has a chance to deal all future damage at once[/p][p]- [b]Page of Power: Spotless Floor[/b] is temporarily unavailable in-game [i](ongoing rework: now adds +5 Base Damage to all instances of damage)[/i][/p][p]- [b]Page of Power: Bleedthrough[/b] can now appear in Raids[/p][p]- [b]Page of Power: Pierce the Veil[/b] once again behaves correctly with Punctuate[/p][p]- [b]Page of Power: Tick Tick Boom[/b] adjusted status icon[/p][p]- [b]Page of Power: Undivided Attention[/b] no longer has an effect chance (should be more consistent with spells like Manifest)[/p][p]- [b]Movement: Circulate[/b] should no longer become unusable when combined with cooldown reduction effects[/p][p]- [b]Inscription: Flow Rate[/b] now properly lists +1% Speed per Stack[/p][p]- [b]Torn Page: Oh Rats![/b] will no longer summon rats from inappropriate foes[/p][p]- [b]Vignette: Thesis, A Ship Rewritten[/b] has minor hull adjustments[/p][p]- Safety save snapshot should no longer happen after a bad loading attempt[/p][p]- Loadouts will no longer show an extra, locked Inscription row[/p][p]- Unstuck button should now fix being stuck in the ground[/p][p]- Camera shake effects will now properly appear in multiplayer [/p][p]- Adjusted some Page drop filtering[/p][p]- Fixed navigation in forest biome Boss Arena[/p][p]- Enkindle effects should correctly clean themselves up[/p]

notes.title: Vellum Edit Patch - 1.1.1
notes.notes: [p]Hello Scribes! [/p][p]As the champions of the Illuminated Library face [b]Yonder[/b] - [i]and the Tangent Tear-ors within[/i] - we've taken a quick pass at mending some other creeping errors in a bugfix patch! [/p][p][b]Thank you for playing[/b] and sharing your experiences with us! Detailed bug reports help us immensely in tracking down and investigating ways to make [i]Vellum[/i] as smooth as possible.[/p][p]Quick highlights of today's patch:[/p][list][*][p][b]Added new Disconnect messaging for diagnostics[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Solved some Yonder encounter-blocking bugs[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Please continue to let us know about any issues you encounter in [i]Vellum[/i]. Go save a Library![/p][p][i]- The Vellum Team[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]Vellum Edit Patch - 1.1.1 Patch Notes[/h1][h2]General and Yonder Fixes[/h2][p]- Added new Disconnect messaging for diagnostics[/p][p][b]- Signature Ink: Green[/b] Inkling transformation timer decays at the proper speed again[/p][p][b]- Signature Ink: Yellow[/b] Flourish will no longer "time out" incorrectly before being consumed (e.g. Concoct and other spells should now consistently flourish)[/p][p][b]- Page of Power: Pretender to the Throne[/b] now properly interacts with Bosses[/p][p][b]- Page of Power: Timelord[/b] has new safety mechanism for Scribes, and now affects Torn at a consistent rate[/p][p][b]- Page of Power: Dyson Em Up[/b] now maintains effect uptime appropriately[/p][p][b]- Raid: The Taking Tree[/b] has adjusted terrain to give transformed Inkling more consistent access[/p][p][b]- Raid: Chronomalus[/b] hourglass sands and related effects are now more clear[/p][p][b]- Raid: Chronomalus[/b] fixed an issue with Fixate behavior[/p][p][b]- Raid: Perplexicon[/b] Keywarden Platforms should behave more accurately with terrain based effects (e.g. aiming Orange Signature Spell)[/p][p][b]- Raid: Perplexicon[/b] Keywarden Platforms will stay appropriately hazardous for the duration of [i]Shelf Sanitization[/i][/p][p]- [b]Raid: Perplexicon[/b] out-of-bounds reset now throws Scribes higher (should result in more control, less risk of frustrating chain fallouts)[/p][p][b]- Raid: Perplexicon[/b] health adjustments should no longer incorrectly end the encounter early[/p][p]- [i](Known issue: If activated/released too quickly, Orange Signature Spell may fail to fire in Perplexicon encounter)[/i][/p][p][b]- Raid: The Brainstorm[/b] planets are now indestructible[/p][p][b]- Raid: The Brainstorm[/b] now appropriately clears Wind buff from Scribes[/p][p][b]- Raid: The Tangent Lord[/b] - Clatter cooldown adjustments to reduce clipping back-to-back casts[/p][p]- Reset Mover/sensor collider on Map change[/p][p]- Updated various Yonder encounter ability names[/p][p][b]- Vignette: Thesis, a Ship Rewritten[/b] has been adjusted slightly[/p]

notes.title: Vellum 1.1: Beyond - Now Live!
notes.notes: [p][b][i]The time has come to face The Tangent Lord - welcome to Vellum 1.1![/i][/b][/p][p]This end-game focused Major Chapter brings Scribes to the frigid realm of [b][i]Yonder[/i][/b]! In 1.0, we dove deep into the beautiful terror of [i]The Grey Area [/i](home of the Ravings) and the grand machinations of [i]The Forgery [/i](lair of the Splices) - and now, the [b]Tangents[/b] take their turn![/p][p]As always, you can chart the condensed [i]Vellum[/i] journey below - or see the full timeline in game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/625f08e7ec388f80e841dfa4c82ec230860ca6a9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Last Lord of the Torn - Third Time's The Charm[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/1201ed20d126a10825c2c2d59a524573408a43ee.png"][/img][/p][p]Deep in the cold reaches of curiosity itself lies the realm of [b]Yonder[/b] - home of the Tangents! [/p][p]As befitting a dangerous lair of a Torn Lord - [i]Yonder[/i] holds mechanically complex encounters to tackle solo or with your local book club and friends. [/p][p]Normal difficulty unlocks after reaching [i]Attunement 20 [/i]and completing The Grey Area and The Forgery. [b]Yonder[/b] is built to challenge Scribes in the [i]end-game[/i]: maximum Ink Level and strong build-making recommended. For Hard Mode... you'll need to make every drop of ink count.[/p][p]Like the previous Raids, Scribes will venture through 4 Major Encounters and 2 Vignettes - with typical runs targeting 30 - 45 minutes. That said - [i]time can be a tricky companion![/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Yonder - The Tangent Plane[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/a97bc458e51d369937cf652c0f32878bb941471c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Yonder [/b]is the plane of Tangents: an ethereal, hauntingly cold realm devoted to curiosity itself. Here, Scribes will brave the orbit of the Tangent Lord's obsessive, deepening struggle with the unknown. [/p][p]If the Illuminated Library's champions can outmatch a time-oppressed maw, breach a top-secret silo, and weather a torrential storm of ideas - Scribes will find themselves under the intense scrutiny of The Tangent Lord, ever-watchful for answers. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/2b040ec56ce89fdaf3a0055d19d1215e3c2e5303.png"][/img][/p][p]Once more, Scribes will face terrors far from the safety of the Font. Defeat the third Torn Lord, uncover the last piece of Prism's Final Chapter, and continue the legacy of the Illuminated Library![/p][p][/p][h2]Raid Rewards - Winging It![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/47e4b659fd78bafb262211e834cfdfc3ea604188.png"][/img][/p][p]New [b]Curiosities[/b] are now available! No more window-shopping amid flights of fancy - you can go beat the Torn Lords with your favorite Signature Inks and reap the rewards![/p][p]Nook items will also continue to drop from [b]Yonder[/b] encounters - and the pool of Pages of Power grows with some radical new additions! Go defend the Library and make your style known![/p][p][/p][h2]Epilogue - The Next Pages[/h2][p]With all three Raids completed - [i]The Grey Area[/i], [i]The Forgery[/i], and [i]Yonder[/i] - we've finished some of our largest, most complicated pieces of content yet! While 1.1 fills out the events of Prism, Myriad, Verse, and Horizon's saga - there is more [i]Vellum[/i] to be made![/p][p][b]Next up[/b], we're looking to dive deep into community feedback in some key areas - balance, performance, and accessibility. [b]Feedback[/b] is huge for us - if you're enjoying the game, please consider joining our Discord and/or leaving a review on Steam![/p][p]The [url="https://discord.gg/vellum"]Vellum Discord [/url]is a wonderful place to group up with other Scribes, learn, and share your experiences with the game! It's also a great way to let us know ([i]via active discussions, 300+ message long threads, and more[/i]) what aspects of [i]Vellum[/i] resonate with you ([i]and what you'd like to see more of[/i])![/p][p]The Tangent Lord awaits new challengers - and we can't wait to see you brave these twisted encounters! [/p][p]Thank you for continuing the journey of [i]Vellum![/i][/p][p][b][i]- The Vellum Team[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Chapter XII: Beyond - Vellum 1.1 Full Patch Notes[/h2][p][/p][h3]Raid: Yonder[/h3][p]- Venture into the Realm of Tangents[/p][p]- 4 Major Encounters & 2 Raid Vignettes[/p][p]- Normal & Hard Modes[/p][p]- New Curiosities now available for beating all Torn Lords[/p][p]- New Page of Power Rewards[/p][p]- New Nook Items[/p][p]- Codex Badges for Victorious Builds[/p][p]- Music - Underscoring the abstract challenges of curiosity![/p][p]- Lore - Thwart the Tangent Lord and uncover the last piece of Prism's Final Chapter![/p][p][/p][h3]General[/h3][p]- New Signature Challenges for Wing Curiosities[/p][p]- Raid Ink Color Achievements now show progress[/p][p]- Blot Keyword "Spread" now requires an entity be targetable (no more spreading to Araxiom eggs)[/p][p]- Target Practice minigame in the Illuminated Library will no longer auto-complete[/p][p]- [b]Vignette: Lighthouse[/b] now has additional routing options[/p][p]- [b]Tangents[/b]: Minor Torn are allowed to jump again (should result in fewer stuck enemies)[/p][p]- [b]Book Club[/b]: Special Pages (e.g. "The Bearer") can no longer be omitted [/p][p]- Green Inkling passive damage augment calculations clamped[/p][p]- [b]Page of Power[/b]: [b]Murder[/b] (Swoop) now reduces the damage of each bird by 35%[/p][p]- [b]Page of Power: Fine Control[/b] is triggered on Flourish Spell cast now (was on Flourish damage dealt)[/p][p]- [b]Tome: The Wolve[/b]s should no longer apply infused mana effects when siphoning Scribe mana and damaging at the same time (wild bug!)[/p][p]- Ghostwrite: Scribes will no longer take damage during Ghostwrite if they have an effect increasing their damage taken[/p][p]- Boss healthbar text spacing behaves better between boss encounters[/p][p]- Unstuck while in the Torn Antechamber will now correctly transport Scribes[/p][p]- Additional safeties for Raid encounter starts[/p][p]- [b]Page of Power: Double Dose[/b] removed from pool/Codex[/p][p]- [b]Vignette: Overlook[/b] increased jump pad safeties[/p][p]- [b]Vignette: Ashen Conflux[/b] changed lore page location[/p][p]- [b]Raid: The Forgery[/b] fixed some out of bounds access in Binding Workshop, Plot Device encounters[/p][p]- Raids: Respawn locations are now inside the area after defeating final bosses[/p][p]- [b]Raid: The Grey Area[/b] - now prevents softlocks from "Unstuck" in Araxiom arena[/p][p]- [b]Raid: The Forgery[/b] - now prevents softlocks from "Unstuck" in Styxen arena[/p][p]- Library: adjusted ink launcher visual alignment[/p][p]- Fixed Vignette secret rewards being multiplied in multiplayer (Oasis, Dark Wall, Light in the Dark, Abandoned Treasure, Boons from the Author, Giant Stump, Alcove)[/p][p]- Fixed navigation hole in Forgotten Grotto[/p][p]- Fixed typo in Delayed Gratification[/p][p]- Fixed typo in cosmetics[/p]

notes.title: Vellum 1.1: Beyond - Arrives June 20th!
notes.notes: [p][b][i]Hello, Scribes![/i][/b][/p][p]We're over a month into the release of [i]Vellum 1.0[/i] (how time flies!) and as always we're in awe of the staggering support for the game! A couple weeks after launch, Scribes welcomed [b]In Circulation[/b], an Interlude Patch with a new movement spell, QOL changes, and so much more! [/p][p]Since then, we've been hard at work designing the next climactic battles between Scribes and Torn - leading up to a confrontation with the final Torn Lord! Ink and quill at the ready, Scribes...[/p][h3][b]Vellum 1.1: [/b][b][i]Beyond[/i][/b][b] releases June 20th![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/c865827374c890472b950bcced0ffcafd489805f.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Play Beyond, Vellum's 1.1 update on Steam - June 20th, 2025![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/7887f3a28ed3196262ae6836a3a964516758b298.jpg"][/img]Explore the edges of curiosity in [b]Yonder[/b], the realm of the Tangent Lord! [/p][p]As with the other two raids, [b]Yonder[/b] will be available in Normal and Hard modes with intense, mechanically complex encounters. You'll have unlimited attempts per run and can tackle these challenges solo or in multiplayer.[/p][p][/p][h1]Epilogue[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/fa416a2a347e49c269318b40c960225f6d0eb76a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Beyond[/b] will include new achievements, lore, wardrobe unlocks, nook items, balance changes, and more![/p][p]As always - we welcome you to come play and make discoveries together, then tell us all about it in [url="https://discord.com/invite/vellum"]Discord[/url] ([i]and show off your Nook designs[/i])! We'll also be sharing details there on early testing opportunities for this upcoming raid. notes.title: Interlude Patch: In Circulation
notes.notes:
Welcome back, Scribes! It's been almost two weeks since 1.0 dropped and we've been blown away by the enthusiasm and support for [i]Vellum[/i]. Thank you!

Today - we're channeling our [i]own[/i] 1.0 excitement into [b]Interlude Patch: In Circulation[/b]!

This update includes [b]Circulate[/b]: a new [b][i]Movement Spell[/i][/b], [b]Performance and QOL Upgrades[/b], [b]Book Club Reward Updates[/b], [b]Vignette Secrets[/b], an [b]Ascendant Rewards Adjustment[/b], [b]Raid Tuning[/b], [b]Photosensitivity Mode[/b] and many bug fixes.

Check out the highlights of this patch below and watch for our next update: [b]1.1 - Beyond[/b]! As always, you can track our journey from the [b]Roadmap[/b] in [i]Vellum's[/i] main menu [i](quite the saga!)[/i]. 

[h1]New Movement Spell - Circulate[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ca28858adf34289cec867609af7f6cc8fbb060c7.gif[/img]
[i]Go for a leisurely scroll...[/i]

Build momentum with mounting anticipation and a trusty Scroll - then zoom off [b]into and through[/b] your foes with the first Movement Spell to have [i]baseline damage[/i]!

What wild combos will you skillfully scrawl into existence? Use the new Pages of Power and clever strategy to show the Torn what 'doom-scrolling' really looks like!

[h1]Vignette Secrets?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8bf32d31898ec7b07274155cecb1f849ee63763f.jpg[/img]
Intrepid adventurers may have noticed some extra secrets and rewards in the various Vignettes found within the Tomes. Sometimes these hidden rewards give new Pages of Power, Temp Mana, or other useful statuses. 

I dare not speak further of such secrets - only to say that [i]previously secret-lacking[/i] [b]Vignettes[/b] are now up to date with something [i]more[/i] to discover. Happy hunting!

[h1]Performance and Quality of Life[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8050a093ceadb6206fd5c597019823b10435b378.jpg[/img]
Performance and quality of life have been top of mind for us since the 1.0 launch! With today's Interlude Patch, we're taking a more ink-laden pen to performance! Many of the wild interactions between mechanics in [i]Vellum[/i] come down to core building blocks: [b]Projectiles[/b], [b]Areas of Effect[/b], [b]Statuses[/b], and [b]Augments[/b]. Improvements in this patch aim to smooth out each of these pillars' performance - both in solo and multiplayer games!

We've also made a number of networking changes and upgrades aimed at improving the stability and synchronization of your team-up scribbling adventures!

Elsewhere, in the realm of [b]Quality of Life[/b] - we're directly addressing feedback in a few key areas: we're adding [b]new toggles[/b] for photosensitivity and visual effect intensity, we've clarified [b]language and tutorials[/b] in the beginning of the game and throughout the Binding/Attunement/Ascendant processes, and smoothing out other experience-impacting bugs!

Please continue to share your feedback with us as you interact with these systems!

[h1]Reward Upgrades - Book Club & Ascendant Progress[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/363701efba78a54b73b758b7f3d8e2c43f646850.jpg[/img]
[b]The Book Club[/b] is now more rewarding! From now on, you'll be able to gain a first-time [b]500 Quillmark + Gilding[/b] bonus from playing new Book Club challenges - the perfect way to spice up your journey as a Scribe. Because Book Club challenges are ink-level-agnostic, tackling the Book Club right after Ascending may be a great way to kickstart your level-ups! On that topic...

Ascending is now more clear, [i]no longer restricts[/i] Tome access, and will now allow multiple Bindings to drop at once when Over-binding Tomes! As a bonus - Ascendant Scribes also start with [b]500 Quillmarks[/b] to more flexibly reignite their journey!

Ascending in [i]Vellum[/i] is designed to be an optional way to continue playing the game - we want it to be rewarding and fun, but not feel like a mandatory part of your journey. We'll continue to keep an eye on this system - let us know what you think!

[h1]Raid Tuning[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/0b0224fc2ac769a90ecd012f54de11a60084051b.jpg[/img]
We're adjusting and improving many aspects of the Torn Raids - from multiplayer scaling and boss ability frequency to visual telegraphs and Codex hints. Full details are in the patch notes below, but [b]Araxiom[/b], [b]The Taking Tree[/b], [b]Styxen[/b], and [b]both Torn Lords[/b] have all received adjustments.

[b]Quillmark[/b] and [b]Gilding[/b] rewards have also been increased to help celebrate your victories!

[h1]Epilogue[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ed9da06cc93332211e5af73045db22f8cc7fc052.jpg[/img]
[i]Eyes on the Horizon...[/i]
[b]1.1 - Beyond[/b] is coming soon and the Tangent Lord's curiosity knows no bounds!

In the meantime, come join us in the official [url=discord.gg/vellum]Discord[/url] to share your feedback and show off your achievements, strategies, and your Reading Nooks designs [i](in a new dedicated channel)[/i]!

If you've been enjoying your time in Vellum, please consider leaving a review on Steam [i](it's a huge help, we read them all, and we always love to hear about your experiences)![/i]

Thank you for playing [i]Vellum[/i] - write on!

- [i]The Vellum Team[/i]

notes.title: Vellum 1.0 - Out Now!
notes.notes:
It's time to grab your quills and inkwells, Scribes; [i]Early Access is now complete![/i]

[i][b]Welcome to Vellum 1.0 - let's take a look![/b][/i]
[previewyoutube=dZbPQXX25O0;full][/previewyoutube] Together, you've helped us take [i]Vellum[/i] on a journey through [b]23 major updates[/b] - crafting 13 new [i]Spells[/i], three new [i]Signature Inks[/i], hundreds of [i]Pages of Power[/i], new arenas and biomes, Torn [i]Elites[/i] and [i]Bosses[/i] , a dreamy new [i]Illuminated Library[/i], customizable [i]Reading Nooks[/i], and countless other improvements of all shapes and sizes!

Just to keep track - sneak a peek at all the progress we made since [i]March 28, 2024[/i]! For the sake of an image that fit - we combined all the Interlude Patches into their nearest Major Chapter [i](the in-game roadmap remains uncollapsed, go check it out)[/i]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/625f08e7ec388f80e841dfa4c82ec230860ca6a9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Raids - The Ultimate Test of Ink![/h1]
The saga of Scribes & Torn spills over into new ground as we come face to face with [i]Vellum's[/i] most perilous challenges yet - [b]Raids[/b]! [b]The Grey Area[/b] and [b]The Forgery[/b] are dangerous worlds containing brutal new bosses, devious  encounters, and dramatic confrontations directly with the [b]Torn Lords[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/f9b7c8f2e87bc692e11bfa32165c8e11c93cdaad.jpg[/img]
Scribes will be able to take on the intense and climactic challenges of [b]two Raids[/b] - each with Normal and Hard modes - setting the perfect stage for uncovering and thwarting the Torn Lords' meticulous plots. 

You'll face mechanically complex encounters all fully available solo or with your closest pen-pals. Normal difficulties unlock at [i]Attunement 7 & 14[/i] - tailored for a good early to [i]mid-game[/i] challenge, while Hard Modes are built for an [i]end-game[/i] experience (unlocking after completing Normal).

By the numbers - Scribes braving these newest threats to the Library will see 4 Major Encounters and 2 Vignettes in each Raid with typical runs targeting 30 - 45 minutes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/3d45456203d463169578524bd463a5ee756a8f2a.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Grey Area - Home of the Ravings[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/af7999ca2f4b59706bb5d72d79ba35bd291f69f1.jpg[/img]
[b]The Grey Area[/b] is the realm of the [i]Ravings[/i], a forested and decaying keep where Scribes will brave the Raving Lord's twisted view of beauty. If they can defeat an arachnid general, navigate a haunted forest, and nip a terrible plant in the bud - Scribes will reach the Raving Lord's citadel and the malevolent ambition within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/183a0b381be91304033fbc9b9e0cf8f96d8c072d.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Forgery - Land of the Splices[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/43df82083a753246541bde83061cf8896d9543c1.jpg[/img]
[b]The Forgery[/b] is the realm of the [i]Splices[/i], a sandy lava-filled foundry, where Scribes will see the dazzlingly awful machinations of improperly used pages and ink. Here they will confront the Splice Lord after carving their way through his dreadful armory, fearsome constructs, and ever-unfinished fortress.

For the first time, Scribes will battle [i]outside[/i] the books and without the help of the Library. How will their Ink fare in the dreaded Torn Realms?

[h1]Raid Rewards[/h1]
This 1.0 update also brings many raid-related rewards including customization for your personal Reading Nooks and new Pages of Power to use in your Tome runs. We're also introducing a new way to customize your Scribe's wardrobe - [b]Curiosities[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/87210b2d50ea898aba8eeff4c9d16c825cd6613f.jpg[/img]
As Scribes encounter the terrors of the Torn Realms, the Codex will update to provide helpful [b]Encounter Info[/b] about each challenge within the Raids. Every completion of a Raid will also [b]Stamp Each Page, Spell,[/b] and [b]Signature Ink[/b] used in your winning builds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/2678cb04f4c8c1283d821a0631f60f4df9b4d3d7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Quality of Life, Balance, and Everything[/h1]
It just wouldn't be a Major Chapter without a whole list of other improvements, would it - and how better to wrap up Early Access than taking a crack at a few community-requested items? Let's review some!

In the eternal campaign to get everyone to read more... [b]Status Effects are now hoverable[/b] and include as much supplemental information as possible! Though some select effects may retain their - uh - mysterious natures [i](we totally know what they do)[/i].

We've tackled more areas in pursuit of clarity - in fact - you can now see more areas with today's inclusion of [b]Camera Distance[/b] and [b]Camera FOV[/b] settings! The Torn never looked so menacingly scary... or so tiny, cute, and far away? On that topic...

Since early on, we've seen feedback on enemy visual clarity. Not only in moment to moment gameplay, but also when picking Torn Pages! Our strategy in 1.0 allows the dreaded Torn to soak up a [b]hint of identifiable color[/b] from the Tomes they're invading - but only based on their type! You'll see a bit of [i]Green[/i] in [i]Raving[/i] foes and abilities, [i]Red[/i] in [i]Splices[/i], and [i]Blue[/i] in [i]Tangents[/i]. This also applies to their names, allowing you to more confidently target the greenish bear over yonder after picking [i]"Ravings will now sit and taunt you after missing 3 spells."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/85f01042344eaa8624959cd037e7956efd7498da.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Story Continues[/h1]
The realms of the Torn hold many dangers and many answers - from the depths of the Raving Lords's [i]Haunted Metaphorest[/i] to the Splice Lord's [i]Maxim Excavation[/i], the story of [i]Vellum[/i] continues to unfold.

Scribes who best these Raids will prove themselves ready to defend the [i]Illuminated Library[/i] from the Torn's next challenge - the confounding secrets of [b]Yonder[/b], home of the Tangent Lord. This third Raid will be available after launch.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/1ff06c0c1b2b6dd44d99cb95365ebfe102597ba1.jpg[/img]
[h1]Acknowledgments[/h1]
Whether you've lived with [i]Vellum[/i] over the last year or are just about to crack open the magic Tomes for the first time - we offer you our sincerest thanks and simply cannot wait for you to play. 

We're always eager to hear about your experiences in [i]Vellum[/i] - they continue to help us make the game better. If you play and enjoy the game, please consider joining our [url=http://discord.gg/vellum]Discord[/url] and/or leaving a review on [b]Steam[/b] [i](even if it's only to tell us the name of your favorite book of all time)[/i]!

Thank you for joining our book club - enjoy [i]Vellum[/i]! 

[b][i]- The Vellum Team[/i][/b]

notes.title: Interlude Patch: In The Edit
notes.notes:
Welcome, Scribes!

We hope you've been enjoying all the cozy additions to the new Illuminated Library! Today, we're publishing [b]Interlude Patch: In The Edit[/b]! With the sheer amount of new goodies in our previous Major Chapter - today's patch was the perfect opportunity to take a hard look at every nook and cranny of Vellum, dip into the magic ink, and come up with a myriad of improvements.

This update takes a massive step in the Performance, Balance, Reworks, Polish, and [b]so many[/b] aspects of Vellum!

[h1]Performance, Art[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/97f8c99844526e1057e108161b5d07de42c5a5c6.jpg[/img]
[i]We're addressing one of the Torn's greatest weapons against the Scribes - Framerate.[/i]

We've made [b]absolutely massive[/b] strides in the performance of the game. Playing through a Tome, picking upgrades, waiting for the enemy to begin a battle, casting spells - there are thousands upon thousands of connections between the host of systems in Vellum.

Reducing the performance cost in[i] any single item[/i] could have huge gains. 

We've reduced the cost of: [b]Projectiles, Area Effects, Scribe Passive Stats, Torn Passive Stats, Status Effects, Pages of Power, Signature Ink core mechanics, User Interface items, Screen Effects, Fog, Lighting, every action Scribes and Torn take[/b] - oh and the small item of [b][i]networking all these things[/i][/b].

Multiplayer Games, High Appendix Runs, Steam Decks, PCs of varying power - no matter how you enjoy the magic ink, [i]Vellum [/i]just became that much smoother to play!

[h1]Balancing Spells and Ink[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/7af1cccf7016113be533f5e4ddb360e25da13d9c.jpg[/img]
[i]Spells and Ink... dripping with potential![/i]

We're buffing many spells in many ways based on feedback and the continually awesome community discussions! This also comes with some strategic redistribution of power of some spells ([i]Eclipse[/i]) and a handful of minor (but needed) nerfs ([i]Ghostwrite, Vault[/i]). You can read the huge amount of changes in the patch notes a the end of this blog post.

Affected Spells - [b]Punctuate, Quip, Draw, Swoop, Passage, Blossom, Eclipse, Foreshadow, Flutterstep, Ghostwrite, Vault[/b]

Our goal with these changes is to make these spells all more competitive, while opening up their viability when combined with different signature inks (e.g. Draw)! 

On the Signature Ink front, MANY inscriptions have been rebalanced and [b]Green Ink[/b] has been the recipient of several quality of life changes (like a hud indicator) and significant buffs.

[h1]Remastering Tomes and Pacing[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/463096fae2a2a31aa889c31bc64220f542cb9899.jpg[/img]
[i]The Scribes explore magical strengths, collecting powerful Pages - and the Torn rise to meet them...[/i]

Tomes are the battleground of our colorful conflict with the Torn! Bigger and more compelling threats invite stronger choices and more dynamic strategies.

We've refactored the way encounters happen throughout the Tomes - strangely, it's a lot of work that hopefully fades into the background! You'll see a larger variety of foes as you play and the danger ramps up - setting you and the Torn up for more dramatic, compelling, and fluctuating battles!

For new players - we're also opening up the choice to jump into Appendices from the very start! 

[h1]The Clarity of Bindings and Bosses[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ac56f3d552e8666d04878065eee437411df429b0.jpg[/img]
[i]Deeper evils fester and brood![/i]

Bindings have been rebalanced - we're upping the point values to give you more customization AND clarity in the ever-evolving battle with the Torn. Many Bindings now contribute much more to the Attunement goal while playing - though be warned, the Torn still grow stronger!

At the end of these newly re-organized Tomes, held together with reevaluated Bindings - who better to test your rebalanced Spells and Ink against than the [b]Torn Bosses[/b]?

We'll be focusing (and talking) more on Bosses in the future - but [b]In The Edit[/b] brings some fresh polish to our grand foes! There are visual and audio feedback enhancements across the board, with some behavior and cooldown adjustments thrown in - all in service of boss fights that put your Scribe skills to the ultimate test ([i]while being clear, fair, balanced, and satisfying[/i]). 

[h1]The Polish of Pages - and All Other Things![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/1855658b811bfe1fe9874ff28bedfaa6244b0bb1.jpg[/img]
[i]Details on details on details...[/i]

This interlude patch includes so much additional detail - Chapter endings, UI sound effects, fanfare, feedback, and so on! One of the most noticeable changes will be Pages of Power, now much more clearly identifiable in their grandeur!

Magical Pages will now be appropriately decorated as [b]Storied[/b], [b]Renowned[/b], [b]Epic[/b], [b]Legendary[/b], or [b]Unique [/b]([i]if you're lucky enough to read one[/i])!

If any details stand out as your favorite or you have feedback to share with us, please do! So much of this update was driven by feedback; it is truly helpful to us.

[h1]Epilogue - One Big Library[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/49f6ec2addd14be460062522516bce050963140e.jpg[/img]
[b]Interlude Patch: In The Edit[/b] also brings a handful of new Nook items - and introduces the community-requested ability to place items under tables (push in your chair, create your own dioramas, get creative)!

This update went through a fluid process with a lot of builds going on the testing branch. Hunting bugs, giving suggestions, breaking things in brand new ways - thank you everyone who tested[b] In The Edit[/b] ahead of time! 

As we look to the horizon, [i]Vellum's [/i]full launch is drawing closer - and you can [b]definitely [/b]expect it to be a rather large update! In preparation for 1.0, we'll be targeting smaller, Interlude Patch-sized updates (a truly hilarious thing to say in this particular blog post - yes) that will allow us to stay responsive to feedback, squeeze in some cool extra stuff, and keep focused on the next verse of this saga!

Thank you for playing Vellum - go read a book!

- [i]The Vellum Team [/i]

Gildings (gained in the normal course of mending Tomes) are the primary unlock method - though some items may require specific achievements to acquire. 

After completing a [i]particularly economic Tome[/i] - new items will also drop when mending Tomes!

Will you craft a cozy, comfy, fire-lit nook? A whacky shrine? A gallery? It's up to you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8030e474c1741a9011201307c259f0677732ec35.png[/img]

[h1]Tome Novelties - Pet The Wolves, Race Your Friends![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/9cea746bd79b3ccbe110ce54d48571acebfe7a83.jpg[/img]
As mysteries unfold and Scribes continue the battle against their new colorless foes, something strange has begun... 

[b]Novelties[/b] from the Tomes have followed us back to the Illuminated Library! These entries appear while progressing through Vellum. In our overview video above, we show two of these strange happenings.

First - and perhaps the most important - Dawn and Dusk appear [i]AND YOU CAN PET THEM[/i]!
Second - after a fabled Tome concerning contests of speed - [b]Race Courses[/b] become available in the Library! 

Host a friendly test of speed with your fellow Scribes, with unique courses based on your Movement Spell!

Each Tome will affect the Library after the first mending - there's so much to discover!

[h1]Inscriptions, Speed, and More In Store![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/64468ce0e0f6efe8e360e956dfe26f2fb896eee6.png[/img]
The Font of Ink facilitates travel through Tomes - but also throughout the Library! The [b]Inkways[/b] speed Scribes on their way from shelf to shelf!

Coalesced ink can be found and collected in the form of Quillmarks - but also give some extra speed in these great halls with the help of [b]Library Inscriptions[/b].

Learning from our fabled tortoise - slowing down to examine the details of the Illuminated Library may be a quick path to some additional insights into the literary world of [i]Vellum[/i].

[h1]Gameplay Tweaks - Page Adjustments, Area Effects, More![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/dd3603f37d992edf56d3b09147559db4d8144a01.jpg[/img]
And [i]inside[/i] these countless Tomes? For the Scribe on the mending road - we've made a series of gameplay adjustments in [b]Chapter X[/b] (with a much more performance/content/balance-focused interlude patch to come in February) .

On the Page of Power front - we've added pages to help give all Signature Inks access to stronger late-game scaling (particularly in builds with a heavy Generator/Spender damage focus). 

Many Area of Effect attacks/hazards have been converted to cylinders - allowing more accurate safety when jumping over an acid pool or similar effect.

Joust (Punctuate) and Grapple (Quip) have also been updated ahead of their (potential spoilers!) upcoming Book Club challenges!

[h1]Epilogue - At Home in the Library[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/7e35243ac4271050ced2466084daf10a04671394.jpg[/img]

This update spanned several months while we continued our Early Access process. [b]Chapter X: Illuminated[/b] came from a truly monumental amount of intense work and planning that was filled to the brim with twists and turns. 

We've lived in these once-imaginary halls for a while now, working on features and details of all shapes and sizes - we couldn't be more proud to share this new chapter of [i]Vellum[/i] with you.

Welcome back to the [b]Illuminated Library[/b] - happy reading!

-[i] The Vellum Team[/i]

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Author-ity
notes.notes:
Hail, Scribes - and happy New Year!

Welcome to the first update of the year, [b]Interlude Patch: Author-ity[/b]! Wield an expensive new [b]Spender Spell[/b], express yourself with [b]Emotes[/b], test your damage with [b]Endgame Review[/b], relax in new [b]Vignettes[/b], and enjoy many smaller improvements!

[i]O hail the Sovereign Scribe - first of their fame, guardian of the Library, descendant of the first mend, collector of pages and chromatic wielder: INKBORN! [/i]

[b]Overrule[/b] is the newest Spender in the Scribes' arsenal; Ascend and brandish a Sceptre for 2.5s to sentence foes to destruction!

The Torn are indeed difficult subjects - but this high-damage, single-target beam of power might just be the answer! As an expensive spell, make sure to keep 3 mana in your coffers to deal with the challenges throne your way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/493c15b79a04e0f69ef6769ded5ebfe5c609162a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/34b1ae89a071cce7982e6855a616dda1f76ec452.jpg[/img]

[b]Interlude Patch: Author-ity[/b] has tons of goodies to kick off the year, lots of details and some quality of life improvements to accompany the content centerpieces. There's so much more to come as the 1 year mark of Early Access approaches on the horizon.

Good day, Scribes!

Since we Book Club members are facing the same limited-time obstacles, Scribes will be able to review global stat Reports on [b]Completion Time[/b] [i](defeating Ch6 Boss)[/i], [b]Highest Appendix[/b], and a [b]Challenge-Specific Stat[/b] during each challenge period.

How much pet damage did you deal in [i][b]The Lord of the Inklings[/b][/i]? How fared your sword-play in [i][b]Duelist's Fate[/b][/i]? Join the Book Club and put your reading skills to the test! 

[h1]The Shredded Torn[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/b028d3791b850e9e6f594fc298962bd4b2bebd5e.jpg[/img]

The looming threat of the Torn continues to grow with new minor foes for [i]Splices[/i], [i]Ravings[/i], and [i]Tangents[/i].

Face off with the skittish ram-like [b]Gruff[/b], the indulgent [b]Ruminator[/b], and the distantly harrying [b]Apostrophe[/b].

And - upon a mighty wind sails the dreaded [b]Howl[/b] - a bold and zephyrous [i]Elite Splice[/i].

[h1]Going Overboard - Quality of Life, Manifest Rework, And More![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/daed3516868b72bc1b042499238423750ba0b725.jpg[/img]

[b]Chapter IX[/b] is a great opportunity for us to highlight some more community-requested improvements to [i]Vellum[/i]! More information follows in the patch notes, as always - but we wanted to highlight some hits!

[b]Codex Search[/b]: Hunt for pages by name, keyword, or associated spell!

[b]Manifest Update[/b]: Manifest can now be skillfully feathered to maintain some attack speed while avoiding "Going Overboard".

[b]Swoop Adjustment[/b]: This spell can now be repeatedly cast by holding the button!

[b]Inkling Behaviors[/b]: Transformed Inklings will now leap to their targets! Inklings in the Library will follow their Scribe's lead when dropping combat - [i]it's polite to be mindful of others in the Library[/i]!

[h1]Color Your World - Steam Community Items[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/1c8aac9c10034371d67e20ead2453152de64fc13.jpg[/img]

[i]"What's your favorite Ink color?"[/i] became a far easier question for these Scribes - it was obvious from their Steam Profiles!

We've added a whole suite of new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/917950]Steam Community Items[/url] to show off your all-time (or perhaps spur-the-moment) colorful [i]Vellum[/i] favorites!

[h1]Epilogue - On the Nature of Seasons[/h1]
Around this time last year, we were in the early stages of Early Access launch prep. Over the 2023 Thanksgiving break, we had published our announcement trailer and were approaching the Steam Next Fest with a [i]Vellum Demo[/i] that was [i]very quickly[/i] taking on stronger, bolder shapes. Players would go hands-on with the game soon. [i]Real soon[/i].

We previewed [i]Vellum[/i] for many of our friends and family - leaning on a wide range of truly generous folks who offered much of their time to hear about [i]the book game[/i]. 

Somewhere in the middle, [b]our[/b] common refrain of [i]"Could you try some new Vellum stuff?"[/i] transformed into something new and exciting of [b]theirs[/b]:[i]"So I've been playing a bit on my own and I think that..."[/i] -- Not only had our growing circle been kind with their time - but increasingly open with their [b]imaginations[/b] and [b]curiosity[/b]! To see that same generosity then carried on by our players has been truly inspiring.

Today, with our final chapter of 2024 hitting the magic shelves, we're extremely proud of the [i]Vellum[/i] journey so far and the endless discoveries we've made together along the way.

Happy Holidays and thank you for playing [i]Vellum[/i]!

- [i]The Vellum Team[/i]

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Feast
notes.notes:
Welcome, Scribes!

We've loved all the feedback and discussion after [b]Chapter VIII: Hard Cover[/b] and the addition of the [b]Teal[/b] Signature Ink! We continue to gather feedback and have been working on making improvements, with the next step being today's [b]Interlude Patch: Feast[/b]. 

On today's menu: some community requests in the form of [b]Page Omission[/b], dramatically improved enemy [b]Hit Reactions[/b], and major strides in [b]Game Performance[/b]! We've also continued to expand content to add variety to your adventures with new [b]Vignettes[/b] and [b]Player Pages[/b].

As always, you can check the in-game roadmap to see what's coming up. But for now, let's jump into the additions!

[h1]Performance Improvements[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/d65ba51fbd40a91484a9aafb22345e52ee11b323.jpg[/img]
Like the Scribes and Torn - [b]Performance[/b] is an evolving battle. Little wins here and there get pushed back by crazier combos and new features. [b]Interlude Patch: Feast[/b] makes huge strides in winning back framerate with two major areas. 

The first is a new way of handling game actions (projectiles, explosions, arrow rains, etc.) by re-using old copies so we don't need to create or destroy effects each time they're used. This should give a sizable performance boost, [i]particularly[/i] later in Tomes within the Appendices when hundreds of effects are happening every second.

The second big improvement is in how we handle the Torn and their stats and behavior. With some aggressive data caching, multi-threaded logic, and more optimized code flow - we've seen [b]huge[/b] performance gains when there are many enemies on the battlefield.

While there is still plenty of room for improvement, these two major performance overhauls have increased performance in general combat by a [i]significant[/i] degree. And in late game runs, we've easily seen 100x improvements, going from 'seconds-per-frame' to 60fps in many cases! 

[h1]New Vignettes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/863bc3fb1d134391e5d2d94620b7327c9e4c879b.jpg[/img]
Deep within the Tomes, Scribes can find themselves in three new Vignettes! Scale the fungal depths of [b]Mycellum Quarry[/b], take in the view in [b]Overlook[/b], and dance with [b]Radiance[/b].

New Lore pages have appeared in the Vignettes of [b]Pride and Profit[/b], further detailing the paths of [b]Myriad[/b], [b]Verse[/b], and [b]Horizon[/b].

[h1]Hit Reactions[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/2f008d7b5eca9e6bd197b5aa8fa59e7f6e966030.jpg[/img]
Another element of feedback we've seen echoed a number of times is wanting more feedback when you deal damage to the Torn.

This update adds two new interactions - [b]Damage Animations[/b] and [b]Hit Flash[/b]. Now, Torn will physically react to the damage they take, giving better feedback and making damage feel more impactful. Additionally, Torn you damage will flash the [b]color of your Signature Ink[/b], for some visible, thematic interaction.

If you find the Hit Flash distracting, you can disable it in the General Settings menu!

[h1]Pages of Power[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/06a4f33165d8edd7a0f065ff070edf13c07c6636.jpg[/img]
This update expands the Codex with over 20 new Pages of Power to help you push back the Torn! This time, we're focusing on build expansion and collaboration, with new interactions between your spells, as well as a bunch of new multiplayer [b]Ink Combinations[/b] (for example: your Orange Atlas might apply Blot if a Blue Scribe is standing nearby)!

[h1]Page Omission[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/f4eea5a07fbffe3c68a10223f3a8200e5939c51d.jpg[/img]
Sometimes, you might pick up a page that doesn't quite cooperate with your build - now you can do something about it! By popular request, we've added the ability to [b]Remove Pages of Power[/b] you pick up during your run - just hold right click on the page in the Tab menu, and you can [b]Omit[/b] it from your book!

[h1]Epilogue[/h1]
[b]Interlude Patch: Feast[/b] also brings a smattering of bug fixes, adjustments, and some light tuning! We called this update 'Feast' for a few  reasons: to allude to the sheer [b]amount of stuff[/b], the Thanksgiving holiday, but more importantly - the [b]communal nature[/b] of this update!

In each post here, we make a point to write out how thankful we are for the enthusiasm and generosity of our players. Today's patch truly embodies the joy of our Early Access process; nearly every aspect of [b]Feast[/b] has been directly influenced by feedback and discussions in the community.

For those who celebrate it, have a superb Thanksgiving!

[i]Welcome to the table! Heroes, as evening approaches a new blog post appears... It says across the top:[/i]

"Happy Wednesday, Scribes! Vellum Early Access continues the adventure with Interlude Patch: Initiative!"

[i]It continues on, summarizing the game's patch today:[/i] [b]Clatter[/b] - a new generator spell, the [b]Torn Bestiary[/b], [b]Enhanced Healthbars[/b], and the start of [b]Improved Ascension[/b] mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/e907722b7da7723064f0ba95ad69f85b79625081.gif[/img]
[i]You want to battle? Great! [/i]

Roll to attack with [b]Clatter[/b]: a new generator spell that conjures a 20-sided die, then blasts it at your foes!

Clatter applies additional effects determined by the result of your conjured d20. These payloads vary from an explosive area burst generating extra mana at higher numbers to a gut-wrenching single point of damage when rolling a 1.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/d921d5734d5abb0cfdb7c40f8bc01d70b7bfc538.jpg[/img]
[i]I understand - you'd like to learn in the heat of combat![/i]

[i]As a more experienced adventurer, you'd like to reset and try a new path? Right this way...[/i]

[i]Heroes - time for a snack break![/i]

Thank you for your support, feedback, and enthusiasm.

[i]Fun session, friends! Same time next week?[/i]

- [i]The Vellum Team [/i]

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Preposition
notes.notes:
Happy Wednesday, Scribes! [i]Vellum[/i] Early Access blinks forward today with [b]Interlude Patch: Preposition[/b]!

Positions are key in the two new combat Arenas - and Scribes can now equip themselves with a potent teleport: [b]Foreshadow[/b]! New [b]Font Powers[/b] will now appear in Tomes and the game sees widespread performance improvements, bug-fixes, and some nice quality of life features!

As always, the [i]Vellum Roadmap[/i] tracks our journey across the Early Access process - check it out in-game to see what comes next!

[h1]New Arenas - A Destination Shredding![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/42017bd46397f00f98663f2a3f1f3d0f4ba8bdb9.jpg[/img]
Today brings two new combat Arenas! Push back the Torn on a tropical island inlet, complete with boardwalks and palm trees! 

Don't let your ink dry too fast in the second Arena - a mysterious ritual site deep in the desert... High ground, choke points, and a doorway fit for last stands and holdouts!

How shall the Scribes traverse such spaces?

[h1]New Spell - Foreshadow[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/a8b6f39356b5a7569d882c4fe0cdcd39073112e7.gif[/img]

[b]Foreshadow[/b]. With two charges and unlimited range, this Spell lets bold Scribes warp themselves to face their targets head-on.

Be it aggressive gap-closing or panicked escapes - [b]Foreshadow[/b] opens the door for incredibly fast-paced bursts of action.

[h1]Performance Improvements[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/4c4ba3006786bb3e61c9648d16e04e8df40cbf40.jpg[/img]

There are a lot of ground effects in [i]Vellum[/i] at the same time (and sometimes the same space) - which makes today's performance improvements all the more impactful.

Projectors see a massive upgrade, affecting a large number of our area of effect spells and abilities. This should allow for smoother play under those high-load encounters - like when you've chosen [i]"Raving area size increased by 50%"[/i] and can't seem to kill off all those darn scorpions...

Status effects - another widespread pillar of the game - have also seen dramatic improvements. Vellum now handles big stack counts (like with Orange's Survey effect) much more efficiently!

[h1]Font Powers - Thank Our Lucky Stars[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/2422bd8bb2caa31337d2cb0e3b1a5350fd6fba3c.jpg[/img]
We're adding some fresh new options to the general pool of [b]Font Powers[/b]! These powers come in all shapes and sizes - including new drops, some anti-Torn counterplay, a BELL?!, and more. 

With 16 new options in the pool, we're looking forward to hearing about your mid-run choices and discoveries!

[h1]Epilogue and Errata[/h1]
[b]Interlude Patch: Preposition [/b]comes fresh off the heels of a massive [b]Chapter VI[/b] update. We're continually energized to be reading and digesting your feedback -  from feelings on the Mana rework to questions on story elements, it is always an exciting and driving force for us to hear your experiences with [i]Vellum[/i].

We're also thrilled and intrigued when seeing new bug reports! The detail and back-and-forth is consistently helpful for us - and often sets up exciting puzzles for us to solve. Like Scribes, we get to explore the deep dark intricacies of the unknown and come out victorious!

Thank you for playing and helping to make the game better each step of the way!

- [i]The Vellum Team[/i]

[b]Gather 'round, Scribes![/b]

[i]Vellum's[/i] journey continues in [b]Chapter VI: Looming Threads[/b]! Not only does today bring more content, charging forward into the bright future of the game - this chapter also starts the unfurling of a dark past. 

The new spell: [b]Weave[/b], a menacing [b]Raving Boss[/b], [b]Lore Pages[/b], and an evolving rework of [b]Mana[/b] await! 

Speaking of future and past - check out our Early Access progress below! It's a wild ride to read through chapter by chapter and imagine the game way back at the start of this process. No matter when you joined the story - [i]thank you for accompanying us[/i]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/d4c8b221388a3f4da7d46081c4752e8c108f82e7.jpg[/img]
[i]Inspiration is sometimes as simple as a wish granted. A wish denied. - Prism [/i]

The [b]Legend[/b] section of the Codex is now available! Inside, you'll find record of any pages of lore you have encountered in your journey as a Scribe. 

Scattered journal pages - left behind by various authors - will now appear in Vignettes, filling in bits and pieces of a particular history within the world of [i]Vellum[/i]. 

Special note: existing pages (i.e. Library pages) have also been rewritten, but should appear in the Codex if you have progressed far enough.

The story will continue to unfold in future chapters!

[h1]Spender Spell - Weave[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/25bcb8f20b6a631353f5997603b46acf4e9cb2ba.gif[/img]

[b]Weave[/b] a new path forward with the finest threads in fiction! This fresh variable cost Spender allows you to take full advantage of your pool of Mana: each additional Mana spent will summon more Needles. 

Weave: Continually spin mana into threaded needles that seek foes through terrain when released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/ea522f281ef7bc4e8cccc029bcaa3c6f709dbc3c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/cce99d6d7812507f5df07c6a43db6258be4ef4cc.gif[/img]

[b]Mana[/b] plays a central role in both the core combat [b]rhythm[/b] of [i]Vellum[/i] and the [b]identities[/b] of Signature Inks. It has been a topic of incredibly detailed feedback since the beginning of Early Access - so we've had a solid period of time (while working on other game pillars) to collect our thoughts and goals.

[i]This is an evolving rework[/i] - there are further steps beyond today's iteration! The central idea:

[b]At maximum Mana, Generators will start colorizing Neutral Mana. [/b]

We believe this deepens the baseline decision-making around the Mana economy: providing both familiar and enhanced ways to infuse the identity and potency of Signature Ink into your combat style.

Additionally, Scribes can colorize [b]Temporary Mana[/b] - allowing you to actively take better advantage of a great number of pages. We've also introduced new Mana-specific Inscriptions (Ink Level 8) to further customize around your combat preferences.

With the importance of Mana as a fundamental aspect of [i]Vellum[/i], we are deeply interested in your feedback on this change!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/c811519b55f85046386ed4171804ed678a7cd861.jpg[/img]

This is a [b]huge[/b] update for us - iterating on central combat systems, unfolding lore and legend, crafting new bosses, introducing a wild new Spell, and diligently working on pivotal future chapters in the background. [b]Chapter VI: Looming Threads[/b] turns a page toward the wells of inspiration ahead.

Thank you for reading. Thank you for playing!

[i]- The Vellum Team[/i]

[h1]The Hollows - Deep In Thought...[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/da4652968c65e5eb83d097e1a12da0631532daee.jpg[/img]

The Tomes now take us deep into the underground worlds below... Scribes can now find themselves facing off against the Torn in 5 new arenas! Nooks and crannies, pools and precious gems, stalagmites and stalactites (we totally know which is which...), The Hollows have it all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/834afb2401ed210d5474d42ebe8abe99d4ba1c01.gif[/img]

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Full House
notes.notes:
[h1]Interlude Patch: Full House
[/h1]
Good day, Scribes! Welcome to our [i]ninth[/i] update, [b]Interlude Patch: Full House[/b] - introducing multiplayer [b]Quickmatch[/b], the burst-fire spell [b]Draw[/b], [b]Interface Pings[/b], and more! 

We've been openly talking about public games since the launch of [i]Vellum[/i] Early Access, often with the underlying goal of maintaining the best foundation for positive, shared experiences. This is a heavily-requested feature that opens some exciting new doors for Vellum.

Don't forget to keep an eye on the [i]Vellum Roadmap[/i] in-game to keep up with our progress (and catch a glimpse of what might lurk in the shadows ahead)! 

[h2]Quickmatch - A Legendary Study Group[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/b0e88c1df1f8034b15c9e14a70f2360732691ef5.png[/img]
Band together as a team of up to 4 Scribes to push back the Torn! New multiplayer options are available from the Main Menu.

[b]Quickmatch[/b] - Enter an open, Public Lobby in the Illuminated Library.
[b]Create Game[/b] - Choose to create a Public or Private Lobby (Private is open only to Friends/Invite/Room Code)

There are also lobby tools available to the host: Inactivity Kick toggle, Public Room toggle, and individual player kicks.

[h2]New Spell - Draw[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/484d362078fc16daa3a15f5c8be2cd190fb6d045.jpg[/img]
[b]Draw[/b] now has a seat at the Generator Spell table! Our new triple burst-fire spell deals a Hand of Cards (at high speeds) to cut your foes - however, casting too quickly in succession will widen the spread. 

How will you [i]deal[/i] with this new Generator? Let us know if it [i]suits[/i] you! Card pun!

[h2]Interface Pings and Communication Feed![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/8884cdfad531ffdae3847f28669d0842f0ba7321.gif[/img]
[i]"Sharing the joys of discovery and the burden of challenge is core to the Vellum multiplayer experience."[/i]

We dropped this gem of a line in the previous Interlude Patch when introducing the new Ping Rework - with today's patch we get to push further toward that thesis with the new [b]Interface Ping[/b] system. 

In combination with a new [b]Communication Feed[/b], Interface Pings now allow Scribes to communicate where their focus is by pinging areas of the UI itself. This is especially handy for game setup (for example, you can now see and ping your lobby's [i]Attunement[/i] goals in Binding Select). Most items with a tooltip are able to be pinged, as well as buttons to move the game along:

[i]Fletch is ready to continue[/i]

[h2]Performance & More[/h2]
[b]Interlude Patch: Full House[/b] doesn't have John Stamos, but it [i]does[/i] have the next best thing - [b]Improved Performance[/b]! In addition to dramatically improving Library rendering performance, we've introduced a new setting, [i]FSR Upscaling[/i], that will allow for improved performance elsewhere in addition to extra customization across the Quality/Performance spectrum. We're very interested in hearing how these settings impact your play experience - [i]please share your feedback with us[/i]!

On the gameplay side, we've added a few new [b]Pages of Power[/b] for the [b]Jot[/b] spell to start deepening its build potential. We've also squashed some Orange-related bugs, added some size safety mechanisms, and many other bits and bobs you can review in the patch notes below.

Our journey continues into the next big update - [b]Chapter V: The Hollows[/b]! Your feedback continues to aid our process, combat our writer's block, and provide unique perspectives. With Quickmatch arriving today, we're not only looking forward to hearing more from you - [b][i]we're honestly pumped to go play together[/i][/b]!

- The Vellum Team

Welcome, Scribes!

notes.title: Live Update - 0.45.1 - (Difficulty Overhaul)
notes.notes:
Hello, Scribes!

We're releasing a patch today to adjust issues and address feedback relating to difficulty. There are also fixes and enhancements to the recent [b]Chapter III: Revelry & Respite[/b] update!

Overcoming satisfying hurdles is at the heart of [i]Vellum[/i]; Scribes direct the hunger of their foes, apply dangerous Bindings to Tomes, and venture into the depth of the Appendices - all in a quest to battle and defeat the Torn. 

[b]In service of challenge that is consistently satisfying, we're making significant adjustments to Vellum's difficulty.[/b]

Today's patch adjusts how [i]Vellum[/i] scales enemies across the board (Chapters, Bindings, Appendices). First off, we've fixed an important bug that had previously undercut the scaling factor of Bindings - so our intended difficulty curve had been 'leaking' a portion of its potency.

To combine with Bindings, we're substantially increasing the starting health values of Torn - with a small bump to their per-Chapter scaling. We're also adjusting the timing for Barrier regeneration for both Scribes and Torn to take slightly longer - giving more weight to Barrier-related powers and gameplay. We want a much more dangerous - but satisfying - iteration of the Torn:

[b]Our goal is for difficulty to be a better partner for player power - keeping focus on the best dynamic relationships of the game.[/b]

This is an impactful step toward balancing the game, but it [i]isn't the last step[/i]. We're eager to hear your feedback when playing with these changes and examining where [i]Vellum[/i]'s challenges find their brightest spots.

Thank you for playing!

- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Interlude Patch: Till Death
notes.notes:
[h1]Interlude Patch: Till Death[/h1]
Good day, Scribes - we hope you've been braving the seasons and studying up on your Inks since our last Chapter! We've heard a lot of excitement for Pink - thank you for your enthusiasm! Today, we're rolling out our newest [b]Interlude Patch: Till Death[/b]!

This patch addresses community feedback on death, danger, performance, Bonus Objectives, and balance! We also introduce a tiny new Boss we found. Let's take a look at the patch! [i](And, as always, you can check out the roadmap in-game to track our progress - and see what's next!)[/i]

[h2]Revisiting Danger and Death[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/0e329f1014586d7ce5916242c7deee77283dca8d.png[/img]
We love high-stakes windows in games; skill, luck, instinct, preparation - you meet the challenge with everything you've got! Victory or defeat, you face your moment of truth head-on.

In [b]Till Death[/b], we're making targeted changes to improve these moments. Previously, these high-stakes windows came and went too quickly without us [i]knowing we were in them[/i]. That makes it hard for players to excel in the spotlight - to come out with a [i]clear and earned[/i] victory or [i]satisfying and fair[/i] defeat. The goal: [b]You must FEEL when the stakes are high and BELIEVE you can affect them.[/b]

Our major changes: [b]One-Shot Protection[/b], [b]Last Stand Removal[/b] (Solo), [b]Last Stand Rework[/b] (Multiplayer)

[b]One-Shot Protection[/b] - High danger hits are more likely to leave you at low health, allowing for players to react and take more dramatic advantage of moment-to-moment strategy and long-term build-making. This affects all Scribes (any levels, solo and multiplayer) and will not prevent death from intentional "Annihilation-level" events.

[b]Last Stand Removal[/b] (Solo) - We want the "fight for your life!" drama to happen in the naturally occurring dire moments carved out by One-Shot Protection and your defensives/builds. Ink Level revives still function and have new places in the Ink Level unlock order.

[b]Last Stand Rework[/b] (Multiplayer) - Reviving other players functions similarly to the current behavior. Downed Scribes may now choose to activate their Ink Level revives or keep fighting to fill up their revive bar. This bar is still capped and requires a teammate to stand nearby to finish the process. All downed Scribes now use a ranged Ink Torrent spell to damage foes from any range and stay engaged with the game around them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/54c7d3ebae6cd1edf9e1ad747122289f21139135.png[/img]

[h2]Splice Boss - "Big" Cap[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/3cabad2309d1e25f075fefa2022960666a543ae5.png[/img]
We've foraged for a new Boss to add to the Torn roster: [b]"Big" Cap[/b]! This fun little guy is just a cute and cuddly Splice Boss. 

[i]It's probably best to let him plant all the mushrooms he wants...[/i]

[h2]Pages of Power, Balance & Tuning, and Bonus Objectives[/h2]
We keep expanding the Codex! [b]Till Death[/b] (as always) brings new Pages of Power - including an avenue for some Generator-centric builds!

We've also spent some time tuning Blue, not only with some new pages and adjustments, but a buff to the Spread keyword! Blue's ability to tackle larger threats should be enhanced, while still keeping value on multi-dotting.

Bonus Objectives have all been tweaked! Based on some player feedback and a couple pieces of new tech, we've taken a light touch to nearly every Bonus Objective. Notably, we've also taken a performance pass to help clean up some wild and unwieldy combos (or strange occurrences with ally/foes tags getting confused). 

Thank you for playing [i]Vellum[/i] and sharing your thoughts with us!
- The Vellum Team

notes.title: Chapter II: A Study In Ink - Now Live!
notes.notes:
[h1]A Study In Ink - Overview[/h1]
Welcome, Scribes!

[b]Chapter II[/b] is here with [i]Vellum's[/i] [b]first new Signature Ink[/b]! Study up on Pink, Challenges, a new Tome, Boss, and more - but first, let's check out the roadmap progress:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/5caf1721e97a7f849520e314de4b06b961dc134e.png[/img]
This Chapter not only introduces expansions in [b]three different areas[/b] for the first time (Ink, Tome, Boss) - it also brings Signature Challenges and the Quest Board - laying the groundwork for exciting future features! 

As if that weren't enough - we're also excited to address some community feedback with [i]Skimming[/i] and a pair of quality of life features: [i]Page Damage Credit[/i] and [i]Randomized Loadouts[/i]. 

[h2]Pink Ink - Power, Potential, and Payoff[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/44f8f5fd81d351da26d59da59aab9b0d987406cc.gif[/img]
Pink is the Ink of [b]potential[/b]; strategic preparation leads to powerful results as you set up plans - then execute them at the perfect moment. Pink also breaks the rules with its Signature Spell - gaining 2[b] Charges[/b] and a [b]10s Cooldown[/b]! 

[b]OUTLINE[/b] - Spells that apply Outline also store their damage dealt around foes. Lingering Outlines on slain foes become Drafts.

[b]DRAFT[/b] - Condensed potential damage created by Pink Mana.

[b]FINALIZE[/b]- Purge all Outlines and Drafts, dealing stored damage.

[h2]Signature Challenges - Start of the Quest Board[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/b59dfa25aa31982f07661e6a27364b3554c59064.jpg[/img]

The Quest Board will be home to more upcoming goodies in future updates. [i]What else might make its way from Tome to Library?[/i]

[h2]Tome - On the Nature of Seasons[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/4a2737972e1e497c9d8790693d9014da1e66f53a.jpg[/img]
Brave the winter cold, bask in the summer sun, and weather the Torn's relentless hunger in [i]Vellum's[/i] first new Tome: On the Nature of Seasons! This Tome is available on the third shelf after defeating [i]Quarry[/i] and reaching [i]Attunement 15[/i] (or completing any Tome/any Binding level if already meeting these requirements).

Scribes will venture forth to combat the elements and their foes as this new Tome cycles quickly through the seasons! The Font will aid you, making your favored seasons even stronger! 

[h2]New Boss[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711349/325a83c8d390d9c67b52dbb38f7283b7ad7e8a5a.jpg[/img]
[i][b]It won't sting you. Promise.[/b][/i]

Feedback continues to drive us; from the stray ideas and musings to the more fundamental questions and feelings - we truly value and take to heart your responses to [i]Vellum[/i]! We're making a move to address something we've seen a lot of feedback on: [b]movement speed[/b]! 

We've also heard the request for more information on builds - and after the last update - a way to shuffle loadouts quickly! Here's a quick summary of these new adjustments:

[b]Skimming[/b] - Scribe movement speed increases significantly outside combat and directly after movement spells

[b]Pages Damage Credit[/b] - The end of game screen will now show damage attribution to specific Pages (where possible)

[b]Randomize Loadout[/b] - A strange box has appeared next to the Loadout Podium, allowing quick, randomized Loadouts!


[i]Vellum[/i] continues its journey in [b]Chapter II: A Study In Ink[/b] - and we couldn't be more thrilled for you to join us!

- The Vellum Team
